en-US.shortDescription: Stand-In waits on hold and talks to customer support for you, then tells you the ticket number and what was promised.
en-US.fullDescription: Stand-In makes support calls for you. Tell Alexa what went wrong and what you want, for example a refund for a broadband outage. Stand-In opens a case, calls the business, navigates the phone menu, waits on hold and explains your problem. If the agent asks for something only you should say, like a one-time password, Stand-In asks you to join the call instead of reading it out. When the call ends you hear the ticket number, what the business promised and by when, and Stand-In can schedule a follow-up call if the promise is missed. You can ask about any case later ("What happened with my broadband complaint?") or delete it. This is a hackathon demo: every call is simulated against a fictional business (BharatNet Broadband), and Stand-In never dials real phone numbers. Sensitive values are masked, and cases are deleted automatically after 30 days.
examplePhrases: Ask Stand-In to call BharatNet about my broadband outage
Ask Stand-In to get me a refund for the days my internet was down
Ask Stand-In what happened with my broadband complaint
Ask Stand-In to follow up if BharatNet misses the promised date

carouselImages.altText: The Stand-In shield and phone handset logo above the words Stand-In, holds the line for you
